item.title: WSL Announces Local Trials With Wildcards on the Line at the Pipe Challenger
item.description: A look at that local trials draw shows a gauntlet of Pipe savants. Former CTer Zeke Lau stands out in a heavy crew of Hawaiian Pipe regulars.

item.title: Watch the World Surf League’s Pipe Challenger Live!
item.description: The World Surf League has made the call and the Pipe Challenger is a go. Watch the event live with plenty of qualification scenarios on the line.

item.title: Watch Some of the World’s Best Snowboarders Hit a 100-Foot Jump
item.description: Snowboarders like to go big. So when Mark McMorris, Zeb Powell, Brock Crouch, and Kuba Hrones, and many more got the chance to hit a 100-foot jump, they jumped.

item.title: Australian Surfer Knocked off Board By Shark While Surfing at Closed Beach
item.description: After a New South Wales beach was evacuated due to a shark sighting, a surfer was knocked off his board by the same animal.

item.title: ‘I Thought I Was Going to Die’: Surfer Testifies Against Paddleboarder Who Allegedly Assaulted Her
item.description: California State Parks rangers reportedly investigated the charges against paddleboarder Andrew Eric Gustafson as a misdemeanor, then filed them as a felony.

item.title: Newport Beach Rescinds Approval For Wave Pool That Would Replace a Public Golf Course
item.description: There's a fight in Newport Beach, and it's the most Newport Beach kind of fight ever: golf course or wave pool? But the golfers appear to be winning the battle.

item.title: NASA Satellite Images Show Western U.S. ‘Snow Drought’
item.description: NASA says the current pace of snowfall (or lack thereof) has the region facing a "snow drought," a term that indicates a critically low snowpack

item.title: Asher Pacey Is Bleeding Style on a Twin Fin in ‘Ley Lines’
item.description: You've heard of Asher Pacey not because he screams his name online for views, but because he quietly goes about his business of surfing extraordinarily well.

item.title: 330-Pound Bull Shark Caught Near Site of Fatal Attack on Young Australian Boy
item.description: Australian fishermen captured a 330-pound bull shark near the site of last week's fatal shark attack in Sydney Harbor.

item.title: Julian Wilson on How Donald Trump Foiled His Championship Tour Comeback
item.description: Julian Wilson still surfs at a Championship Tour level. But he skipped most of the Challenger Series amidst his comeback. We spoke with him to find out why.
